text:
aj: Quick run through the routing policy editor sandbox. Found a few UX gaps that make it hard to triage rule precedence quickly. Sharing bullets so we can prioritize. :sparkles:

morgan: thank you! bullets pls so i can add to the design board.

aj: 1) the reorder control is almost invisible on hover-only devices. 2) simulation panel floods with verbose entries and pushes the rules list offscreen. 3) validation copy feels like a compiler message.

samir: For reordering, can we add a persistent small badge "drag" and a separate keyboard "grab mode"? e.g. user hits G to enter grab mode, then arrow keys move rule. avoids relying on hover.

kelly: copy suggestion for validation: current: "rule compilation error: selector conflict". proposed: "This rule overlaps with another earlier rule. Click to preview overlap." one short sentence, actionable.

rachel: accessibility: when a rule is moved announce "Rule moved to position 2 of 7" using aria-live region role=status. Also ensure focus remains on the moved item.

aar on: small layout thought 12% of playtests scrolled the list when sim updated; we should pin the viewport while user is actively editing and only auto-scroll after idle.

designbot: sandbox snapshot @2161112222:
```
summary: matches=9, overlaps=2, samples=5
examples: signup:5, api_ingest:3, cron:1
```

aj: sim panel idea: condensed header with three chips: "Matches 9" "Overlaps 2" "Samples 5". clicking a chip toggles a filtered view. keeps default tidy.

samir: implement notes: add a small collapse chevron and default collapsed; throttle sim updates when user is interacting (debounce 700ms). also add a CSS visible-focus class for keyboard-drag.

kelly: copy variants: friendly: "This rule overlaps with a previous rule. View overlap ->" neutral: "Rule conflicts with earlier rule. View details." I'll PR both and include SR-only strings.

rachel: contrast nit: chip text is 3.2:1 on current background. need >=4.5:1 for body. i'll propose darker chip bg and leave a figma note.

aj: also add a small "Show conflicts only" toggle in the rules toolbar so PMs can quickly scan affected rules.

samir: ok i'll take keyboard grab + aria announcements + debounce. daniel or aaron want header collapse animation?

aaron: I can wire the collapse and chip toggles, will keep motion subtle and respect reduced-motion.

aj: thanks all. i'll file a tiny UX ticket list: reorder badge + G grab mode, sim collapse + chips, copy PR, contrast tweak, pin viewport while editing. should be quick wins. :tada:
